'''Clue scroll (hard)''' is an [[anagram clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (hard)|hard]] [[Treasure Trails]]. 

'''{{Colour|red|Warning}}: You must travel through low-level [[Wilderness]] to reach the [[Mage of Zamorak]] to teleport to the abyss. This causes a risk of being attacked by a [[player killer]] and so caution must be exercised before reaching the Abyss.

Contacting the [[Dark Mage (Abyss)|Dark Mage]] via the [[Astral Contact]] spell will '''not''' work for this clue step.
